itemized.wave: itemized-vision(claude-opus-5; 2026-08-19 wave B2 utah chunk r8_02)

contributions.anchor: Box B 'Contributions Received this Period' = 14,770 on the p5 Summary Page, which is also the printed 'Total Contributions Received (Sum of all Schedule A pages in this report)' printed identically on BOTH Schedule A sheets (p2 typed '14,770' and p3 handwritten '14,770')
contributions.detail: Schedule A runs over TWO sheets. p2 (typed, 15 rows) sums 110 + 250 + 300 + 100 + 410 + 250 + 1000 + 100 + 1000 + 1000 + 250 + 5000 + 1000 + 3000 + 500 = 14,270.00 = that sheet's own printed 'Subtotal for this page $ 14,270' (crop-proved: the band one past row 15 renders the printed '$ 14,270' subtotal line, not a 16th entry). p3 (handwritten, 1 row) is 500.00 = its printed 'Subtotal for this page $ 500'. 14,270.00 + 500.00 = 14,770.00 = the printed Total Contributions Received on both sheets = Box B (per-period) exactly. Box C 'Contributions Received Year to Date' also prints 14,770 — this is the cycle's first report so period equals year-to-date, and the cumulative cell is NOT summed as an increment. Independent corroboration: Box F 15,002.80 = Box A 232.80 + Box B 14,770.00.

expenditures.anchor: Box D 'Expenditures Made this Period' = 12,238.52 on the p5 Summary Page, equal to Schedule B's own printed 'Subtotal for this page $ 12,238.52' and its printed 'Total Expenditures Made $ 12,238.52'
expenditures.detail: 14 Schedule B rows on the single sheet p4 sum 697.53 + 380.38 + 647.20 + 770.00 + 100.00 + 118.00 + 150.00 + 607.79 + 83.04 + 919.98 + 1500.00 + 1000.00 + 112.32 + 5152.28 = 12,238.52 exactly = the printed page subtotal = the printed Total Expenditures Made = Box D. Printed grid row 15 is EMPTY (crop-proved) and there is no 15th entry. Box E YTD also prints 12,238.52 (first report of the cycle) and is never summed as an increment. Corroboration on the cover ladder: Box F 15,002.80 - Box D 12,238.52 = 2,764.28 = the printed 'Balance at Close of Reporting Period'.

itemized.in_kind_convention: monetary-only; BOTH conventions tested and they are identical here — no cell, column, marker or annotation anywhere on p2/p3/p4 marks an in-kind gift, and the modern_boxAF v.4.20 form prints no in-kind line, so the monetary-only sum and the monetary-plus-in-kind sum are the same figure and both close exactly (14,770.00 / 12,238.52)
itemized.escalation_note: Six 900-dpi --value cell crops, all as GEOMETRY PROOFS rather than legibility escalations (the sheet is machine type except p3): p2 row 1 rendered '110', p2 row 15 rendered '500', the p2 band ONE PAST row 15 rendered the printed '$ 14,270' subtotal line (proving the grid is 15 rows and that no entry continues below the last rule — the CHUNK_BRIEF trap-5 control), p3 row 1 rendered the handwritten '500-' and p3 row 2 rendered an EMPTY cell, p4 row 1 rendered '697.53', p4 row 14 rendered '5,152.28' and p4 row 15 rendered an EMPTY cell. No figure was doubtful: the filing-fee row reads 647.20 (not the 647.22 recorded for 2016/2018 Commission filings elsewhere in this wave) and the page's own arithmetic closes to the cent on 647.20, so arithmetic closure settles it.

itemized.notes: R Nathan Ivie, Utah County Commission, 'Seven days preceding the Primary Election', report date 22 June 2020, amendment = No (the 'No' radio is filled). FIVE pages, each classified from its own printed header, never by ordinal: p1 cover / p2 Schedule A sheet 1 (typed) / p3 Schedule A sheet 2 (HANDWRITTEN) / p4 Schedule B / p5 SUMMARY PAGE LAST. Form is modern_boxAF, footer revision 'v. 4.20'. PAGE-FACE NAME is 'R Nathan Ivie'; index.csv's channel label is 'Nathan Ivie' — the page face governs. OFFICE: the page prints only 'Utah County Commission' with NO SEAT, while index.csv carries 'County Commission Seat C'; transcribed as printed and NO seat inferred. A TWO-STOCK FILING: Schedule A sheet 1 is the born-digital fillable form filled by machine type, sheet 2 is the same blank filled BY HAND — both are this report's own sheets (each foliated by the filer 'Page 1' and 'Page 2' respectively, each carrying the same 'Total Contributions Received $14,770'), not a bound-in second report. Every date on both schedules is a bare M/D (or '19 June') with NO YEAR, so every row carries needs_review=1 and no year was supplied from the report date. REDACTION: the county blacked out the street portion of every Schedule A address; the city/state fragment survives beside each bar and is the only locality carried. Schedule B carries no address column at all on this revision. The signature on the cover is redacted by a black bar (the county), while the printed name and date are in the clear. NO in-kind entry appears anywhere on the filing. Both sides close EXACTLY on the promoted per-period boxes (Box B 14,770 / Box D 12,238.52), and the whole cover ladder closes independently (A 232.80 + B 14,770 = F 15,002.80; F - D 12,238.52 = 2,764.28 printed at close), so this filing is fully self-corroborating.
